build_command: GOCACHE=<new sha-prune/build-cache> GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -o ws-frame-proxy main.go
dependency: github.com/coder/websocket v1.8.15 already pinned/cached; no download/install

guards.match: SYNC_RESPONSE Snapshot=true, App absent, both exact Script ID+revision present in same frame
guards.mutation: only bad Script data.content appended deterministic comment; declared SHA and other JSON values unchanged
guards.hold: after fault, hold next exact valid matching Snapshot until a negative SYNC_ACK has been observed and controls.release_good_snapshot=true
guards.logs: no raw frame, HELLO credential, Script content, or other object IDs; selected target digests and frame flags only

deployment_build_command: GOCACHE=<new sha-prune/build-cache> GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -o ws-frame-proxy main.go -ldflags="-s -w"
